notes.title: Kuri Kuri Click! 2 ~My Renaissance!~ Releasing June 17!
notes.notes:
Attention oil massage enthusiasts! If you've enjoyed Kuri Kuri Click! and were looking for more will be happy to hear that the next exciting chapter in the oil massage game of the year series, Kuri Kuri Click! 2 ~My Renaissance!~ is coming out next week on June 17th!

This time around, it is a fantasy setting and our hero, Ryou (no apparent relation to the Ryou in the first game) runs a massage parlor tucked away in a quiet forest. A war erupting in the area brings a halt to any customers showing up at his door until he sees Soara (probably also no relation to the Sora in the first game), a wounded female knight, appear at his front door. Weak from poison during a failed battle with enemy forces, Soara takes up Ryou's offer for a massage to cure her of its debilitating effects. Ryou wastes no time in getting his oil massaging hands on this scantily clad, buxom woman.

Curious to learn more about the game? Don't hesitate to click on the store link below and always hit the wishlist button to be informed of upcoming news on this release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2981790/Kuri_Kuri_Click_2_My_Renaissance/
